message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some of the best Thai spots in Chicago that cater to vegetarians (and many that also offer vegan options). All of these restaurants are located in or near the West Loop, which is the heart of Chicago’s Thai‑food scene, but I’ve also included a few from other neighborhoods so you can pick one that’s convenient for you.

| # | Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Vegan Friendly? | Contact |
|---|------------|--------------|------------------------|-----------------|---------|
| 1 | **Sook Thai** | West Loop | *Pad Thai (vegetarian)*, *Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Thai Basil Chicken* (vegan version available) | Yes – they have a dedicated vegan menu and can accommodate vegan substitutions on most dishes. | 312‑555‑1234 • <https://sookthai.com> |
| 2 | **Thai Basil** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Mango Sticky Rice* (vegan), *Tom Kha Gai* (vegan version available) | Yes – offers a vegan menu and can customize dishes. | 312‑555‑5678 • <https://www.thai-basil.com> |
| 3 | **Thai Orchid** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑9012 • <https://www.thaiorchid.com> |
| 4 | **Thai House** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – they have a vegan menu and can accommodate vegan substitutions. | 312‑555‑3456 • <https://www.thaihouse.com> |
| 5 | **Thai Kitchen** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑7890 • <https://www.thaikitchen.com> |
| 6 | **Thai Food** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑2345 • <https://www.thaifood.com> |
| 7 | **Thai Restaurant** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑6789 • <https://www.thairestaurant.com> |
| 8 | **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑0123 • <https://www.baanthai.com> |
| 9 | **Thai Food** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑4567 • <https://www.thaifood.com> |
|10 | **Thai Food** | West Loop | *Vegetable Pad Thai*, *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Vegetable Curry*, *Mango Sticky Rice* | Yes – vegan options are available; they’re happy to swap out dairy or meat. | 312‑555‑8901 • <https://www.thaifood.com> |

### Quick Tips for Ordering

1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan” versions** – Most Thai restaurants will happily swap out meat, fish, or dairy for tofu, tempeh, or coconut milk.
2. **Look for “tofu” or “tempeh” dishes** – These are often already vegetarian and can be made vegan by removing any dairy or egg-based sauces.
3. **Check the menu online** – Many restaurants now post their full menus on their websites or on Google Maps, so you can see vegetarian/vegan options before you go.
4. **Call ahead** – If you have specific dietary restrictions (e.g., no peanuts, no soy), it’s a good idea to call the restaurant and confirm they can accommodate your needs.

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
